name: mdx-forge-language-pack-evals
evidence_rules: local canaries prove repo adaptation shape, not model quality
live model quality must be measured through the fleet eval harness
every model result should be sliceable by language pack, task class, complexity tier, provider family, and runner profile
principal review gates must join eval results to the same evidence vocabulary emitted by run receipts and review packets
standards source fingerprints prove which repo conventions were visible without copying standards text into eval records
toolchain readiness coverage proves whether the local proof command prerequisites were visible before judging a live result
diff language-pack impact proves which stack surfaces a result actually touched before slicing model quality by language
artifact filtering is review hygiene and does not delete backend evidence
forbidden_capabilities: no live provider calls from canaries
